in_arabic.name: Parzheen
in_arabic.long_meaning: Parzheen هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A Persian name derived from the Persian word 'parz', meaning 'lotus', and the Persian suffix '-een', meaning 'having the nature of'. The name Parzheen signifies a woman who embodies the grace, beauty, and purity of a lotus flower.
